breakdown.description: Fanning friction factor is used directly in the Darcy–Weisbach equation without converting to Darcy friction factor.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The core error in the original prompt was using the Fanning friction factor directly in the Darcy-Weisbach equation. The ground truth corrects this by first converting the Fanning factor to the Darcy factor (f_D = 4 * f_F). The agent's generated specification repeated the original error by using f=0.005 directly in the calculation, instead of the correct Darcy factor of 0.02.
